selected_shape.selection_status: Identifiers proposed for T54.2; no compiled registry binding or released status exists now.

dependencies.own_verified_claim: One exact signed Impact operation claim is required for ordinary stable registration; absent/revoked/expired/mismatched claim stays dark.
dependencies.declaration_authority: The SAME CallerMapService.List call resolves DECLARES_OPERATION from its selected exact resolver declaration publication using the current proto-contract authority. No second Atlas query or read-side join is needed.
not_dependencies: independent phebs.protobuf.contract Atlas product record when Caller Map already admits proto-contract
production signing key for source/contract preparation
selection_fences: Impact verified claim plus actual verified Caller Map recipe domains; experimental flags cannot substitute for either stable release dependency
Missing, expired or revoked Caller Map withdraws Impact only and leaves unrelated products governed by their own records
Revoking a separately selected Atlas product does not withdraw this view while the consumed Caller Map proto-contract recipe remains admitted
Current resolver pack1.2 guards apply; retained old1.1.1 catalogs are custody, not serving authority
A field or WIRE record never expands this report shape implicitly

input.paging: Same caller page_size default50/max100 and exact opaque cursor. HTTP lineage maps to MCP declaration_lineage, as existing Caller Map does. Reject mixed field/change/bundle input; no bare operation cross-protocol search.
input.scope: Single repository endpoint scope; repository-overlay attribution does not become focused-local/deployment authority.

output.caller_page: Unmodified typed CallerMapPage from the shared service, including query/declaration/rows/groups/total_matching_rows/pagination/generation/scope/matching_rows_state/caveat. No second read or regrouping.

conclusion.authority: Echo the exact caller generation digest and query identity from caller_page; no synthetic certificate digest.
conclusion.evidence_present: Static caller evidence matches this endpoint scope; per-row resolution applies. This is not runtime impact, completeness or retirement safety.
conclusion.exact_empty: No matching static caller evidence in this exact filtered source scope; this does not establish absence.
conclusion.unavailable: Caller evidence is unavailable for this generation; no zero-caller or absence conclusion is made.

output.coverage: Current exact page leaves optional legacy Coverage/CoverageDigest/AttributionDigest absent. Preserve that absence. Authority/scope/record and candidate census come from exact caller generation fields; never label them a new coverage certificate.
output.new_metadata_bound: Closed shape/state vocabulary, six fixed unavailable-section entries, fixed prose and one existing generation/query identity; no source-sized metadata vectors.

uncertainty_and_empty_semantics: Resolution syntax retains heuristic tier; scip retains derived tier. A resolved declaration-bound source edge is never promoted to exact runtime use.
Unavailable/ambiguous unit attribution remains attached to its real caller occurrence; do not drop it, synthesize an owner or turn it into a missing caller.
Extractor abstention remains an abstention row/reason. Caller Map filtered total may include abstention evidence; evidence_present never means all rows resolved.
An exact filtered zero requires matching_rows_state=exact plus current generation and total_matching_rows=0; it says nothing about sources outside this scope.
Gap/unpublished/partial/failed/refused generation passes through the shared unavailable page: rows empty, no fabricated total0 or complete generation.
Pagination.complete means the selected snapshot query was exhausted, not runtime completeness or full-corpus analysis.
Unsupported sections always remain named unavailable, including when unrelated signed packs coexist.
authority_and_security: Reuse CallerMapService.List and ReadCitation; preserve authorization-first source access and final visibility/source/current-root fences. No legacy assertions fallback and no synthetic joins.
Pin echoed full endpoint, filters, generation/manifest/pairset/publication revision and per-row source.run_id/repository/commit/object_id/blob_digest/range.
Opaque cursor remains bound to exact query, page size, principal/visibility and caller publication; changed source/publication/permission, expiry or eviction refuses it.
Citation transport remains existing exact caller citation reader; request independently reauthorizes and checks generation before one bounded immutable blob read.
HTTP/MCP/UI return the same transport-neutral report. A malformed/crossed/oversized page refuses the whole result instead of rendering partial facts.
Historical contract-impact-report-v2 proof bundles, stored bytes, archive and experimental routes remain unchanged; stable view neither creates nor reads those bundles.

http.input: shape=operation_callers plus existing flat Caller Map endpoint/filter/page_size/cursor fields
http.semantics: Read-only paged view, no durable report write. Existing /api/contract_impact_report and /api/contract_impact_reports/{id} remain experimental v2.

errors.400: Malformed/mixed/unknown shape or invalid endpoint/filter/page size
errors.404: Absent route when release not admitted; denied/missing endpoint nondisclosure; do not leak which source exists
errors.503: Known unsupported report shape on an otherwise admitted report boundary, or required source service unavailable

mcp.input: Same shape and caller query with exact declaration_lineage spelling; no tool-side filtering/grouping
mcp.registration: Tool absent unless own claim and actual consumed verified Caller Map recipe are admitted

ui.binding: Select exact endpoint through existing Atlas/Caller Map discovery; preserve all URL filters and opaque pagination.
ui.presentation: Answer/rows first; authority and unavailable sections disclosed without hiding them. Same CallerMap source-citation component and exact current/gap state.
ui.unsupported: Field/change/saved report modes visibly unavailable in stable operation shape; old experimental v2 mode is separate. Do not offer a saved-report link that has no backing store.
ui.gates: Both desktop and390px level/filter/paging/citation keyboard journey, fail-closed payload checks, console/a11y, scoped deterministic canonical receipts, bundle and interaction notes under DESIGN_CHARTER.

current_runtime_ceilings.qualification: Existing ceilings are engineering admission, not measured operating capacity. No new hard HTTP response cap is claimed here; the prospective tiny-fixture envelope separately limits observed response bytes.

steady_state_cost.request: Exactly one shared CallerMap.List call and constant report metadata projection. Initial/continuation costs, bounded candidate filtering, retained index lookup/record reads, final authority checks and response serialization remain those of Caller Map; no second Atlas/proof query or full-corpus scan. Preserve row objects rather than copy/index them again.
steady_state_cost.citation: Existing reader only: authorization/current-generation checks and one admitted source blob read, at existing2read concurrency.
steady_state_cost.sync_startup_retry_publication: No new worker, source read, timer, scanner, Git/indexer/Buf child, persistent table/schema, durable pin or lifecycle owner. Startup adds one bounded release-dependency/claim decision; revocation removes route/tool/capability. New source publication invalidates through existing reader/cache rules.
steady_state_cost.locks_cache: Reuse existing Caller Map reader/index/binding locks and lifetime; do not hold a new lock across source I/O. No new report cache or separate8index pool.
steady_state_cost.memory_disk_children: Only fixed report wrapper metadata plus existing page serialization; no row clone, persistent disk or extra child per report. Existing worst-case index/publication bounds are retained, not newly qualified by this small population.
